title: Tenancy agreement
ruleSource: Formal parts of a lease and covenants in leases, as set out in the Property Law Practice Handbook 2025 and S.A Badmus' Property Law drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base). To be confirmed by the legal reviewer, including against the Tenancy Law of Lagos State 2011.

parts.text:
THIS TENANCY AGREEMENT is made on {{agreementDate}}
BETWEEN {{landlord}} of {{landlordAddress}} ("the Landlord") of the one part
AND
{{tenant}} of {{tenantAddress}} ("the Tenant") of the other part.
parts.why: Commencement, date and parties with their full names and addresses. A tenancy of three years or less may be made by agreement under hand; longer needs a deed of lease. Source: Property Law Practice Handbook 2025 (formal parts of a lease); S.A Badmus' Property Law drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text:
IT IS AGREED AS FOLLOWS:
1. The Landlord lets to the Tenant ALL THAT {{premises}} situate at {{premisesAddress}} ("the Premises") TO HOLD unto the Tenant for a term of {{termLength}} commencing on {{startDate}} and ending on {{endDate}}.
2. YIELDING AND PAYING the {{rentPeriod}} rent of {{rent}} clear of all deductions, payable in advance.
parts.why: The operative words and parcels, the habendum (certain commencement and end dates, without which a lease fails for uncertainty) and the reddendum (the rent, which must be certain and is not implied, so it is stated). Source: Property Law Practice Handbook 2025; S.A Badmus' Property Law drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base).

The tenant's express covenants: rent, no assignment or subletting without consent, no alterations, repair, permitted use and yielding up. Source: S.A Badmus' Property Law drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base) (lease covenants); Property Law Practice Handbook 2025 (covenants in leases).

parts.text: THE LANDLORD COVENANTS with the Tenant that the Tenant, paying the rent and performing the covenants in this agreement, shall have quiet possession of the Premises without disturbance by the Landlord or the Landlord's agents.
parts.why: The landlord's covenant for quiet enjoyment. Source: S.A Badmus' Property Law drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base); Property Law Practice Handbook 2025.

parts.instruction: If the facts include other agreed terms (for example a service charge, caution deposit or option to renew), set each out as a clause under the heading's numbering (g), (h)…, using only the facts given. If no other terms are given, return an empty text.
parts.why: Any further terms the parties agreed, drafted as express covenants. Source: Property Law Practice Handbook 2025 (express covenants).
parts.heading: OTHER TERMS

parts.text: PROVIDED ALWAYS that if the rent or any part of it is unpaid for twenty-eight days after becoming payable, or if the Tenant commits a breach of any covenant in this agreement, the Landlord may determine this tenancy and recover possession of the Premises in accordance with the law.
parts.why: The proviso on the tenant's default. In Lagos, recovering possession still requires the statutory notices and a court order: a landlord may not simply re-enter. Source: S.A Badmus' Property Law drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base) (proviso for re-entry, adapted). Reviewer: confirm against the Tenancy Law of Lagos State 2011.

parts.text:
IN WITNESS OF WHICH the parties have signed this agreement the day and year first above written.

SIGNED by the Landlord
........................................
{{landlord}}
IN THE PRESENCE OF:
Name: ....................
Address: ....................
Occupation: ....................
Signature: ....................

SIGNED by the Tenant
........................................
{{tenant}}
IN THE PRESENCE OF:
Name: ....................
Address: ....................
Occupation: ....................
Signature: ....................
parts.why: Testimonium, execution and attestation. A tenancy agreement is signed under hand, not sealed as a deed. Source: Property Law Practice Handbook 2025; S.A Badmus' Property Law drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base).
Franking: the legal practitioner who prepared the agreement. Source: S.A Badmus' Property Law drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base).

fields.label: Date of the agreement
fields.question: On what date is it made? Leave it out if it will be dated when signed.

fields.label: Landlord
fields.question: Who is letting the premises? Full name, or the company's registered name.

fields.label: Landlord's address
fields.question: Where does the landlord live or have its registered office?

fields.label: Tenant's address
fields.question: Where does the tenant live now?

fields.label: The premises
fields.question: What is being let? For example: two-bedroom flat on the first floor.

fields.label: Length of the tenancy
fields.question: How long is the tenancy? A tenancy agreement is for three years or less; longer needs a deed of lease. For example: two years.

fields.label: How often rent is paid
fields.question: Is rent yearly, half-yearly or monthly?

fields.label: Rent
fields.question: What is the rent, in figures and words? For example: N1,500,000.00 (One Million Five Hundred Thousand Naira).

fields.label: Permitted use
fields.question: What may the premises be used for? For example: residential.

fields.label: Other agreed terms
fields.question: Anything else the parties agreed, such as a service charge, caution deposit or renewal option.

fields.label: Prepared by
fields.question: Which legal practitioner prepared the agreement?

fields.label: Solicitor's address and contacts
fields.question: The solicitor's address, email and phone number.
